subject: part
title: (R)PART.------C.INFO.
description: Chart on book p. 398 (JR-20). PART (participation) is the subject, with the (R) prefix, "the reality of"; C-INFO (composite information) is the partner. From the subject: SOC-RT-DY (social reality dynamics), SPT-DY (spiritual dynamics) and TR (transformation). From SOC-RT-DY: INVT-DT (investigation dictates). From INVT-DT: EXT-FT (extended functionalism). From SPT-DY: AFI (affinity insight). From AFI: AF-POST (affinity postulation). From TR: PER-DY (perception dynamics) and C-FO-ACT (composite focused activism). From C-FO-ACT: RT-DY (reality dynamics).
